request.prompt:
Create ONE native editable static SVG packed study sheet, exactly 1440 by 672, viewBox="0 0 1440 672". 3 columns by 2 rows, cells exactly 480 by 336, no gutters. Row-major order of named subjects below. Each subject MUST be an individual top-level <g id="SUBJECT-ID" transform="translate(CELL-X CELL-Y)"> using LOCAL coordinates; every group owns its own full-cell dark background rectangle. NO cross-cell content. If there are five subjects, sixth bottom-right cell stays empty dark background in a group id="unused". Keep all subject geometry at least 30 units from cell edges, major silhouette occupies 65-80% of cell. All paint definitions must be local to the group or explicit flat fills. Do not use a shared sheet-wide backdrop.

These are FUTURE EXPANSION ART CONCEPTS for later review, not canonical history or active content. This is an engraved fantasy illustration set: confident irregular contours, expressive asymmetric gestures, three broad value groups, broad sculptural material planes before detail, sparse form-following engraving, no repeated tiny decoration. Connected joinery and credible support. Upper-left light, quiet background #10232c. Ink #10232c, shadow #34464b, worn ivory #ead7b5, muted bronze #b68d62, smoky steel #95a6aa. Emberwake adds moss #7c987a, saltglass #75a99f, restrained cinder #ca7658. Night Passage patron accents: Aster warm yellow #dfc777; Neris aqua #6dbfb0; Vesta coral #d78568; Isen pale ice blue #a5cbda; Nyra restrained lavender #a18cb8. Materials must look different: wood grain follows stress, leather folds, stone thickness, translucent glass has a clear rim and broad transmission planes, metal has restrained flat highlights. No plastic gloss, no golden edge on everything. Do not turn every object into a symmetrical emblem.

Each scene reads as one distinct designed subject at 160x112 and 80x56, and should survive a 64px silhouette glance for props. This is illustration art only: no frame, captions, labels, text, digits, watermark, logo or UI. Static SVG paths and simple shapes only; no raster embedding, image, text, use, CSS stylesheets, scripts, animation, external resources or filters. No inaccessible gradient references. Economical construction with large quiet areas.

SUBJECTS in exact row-major cell order:
Cell 1: id="aster-cloud-vessel"; origin (0,0); Aster cloud vessel. A shallow lidded electrum vessel with an offset stepped lid and three broad slots, seated in a dark stone cradle; quiet warm yellow reflected planes, no lightning icon.
Cell 2: id="neris-current-coffer"; origin (480,0); Neris current coffer. A sea-worn ceramic coffer with one rounded hinged lid lifted to show a pale inner cavity and aqua glass insert; broad wet rim highlights, not a book or scroll niche.
Cell 3: id="vesta-ember-press"; origin (960,0); Vesta ember press. A compact soot-black iron screw press holding a single glowing coal behind a thick slotted copper plate; supported screw and deep recess, no ornamental flames.
Cell 4: id="isen-salt-casket"; origin (0,336); Isen salt casket. A long pale ceramic cold casket whose thick lid slides partly aside, clear dark interior and thin blue frost lip; quiet faceted planes, not a crystal lamp.
Cell 5: id="nyra-folded-screen"; origin (480,336); Nyra folded screen. Three unequal folded panels of dark plum cloth framed in blackened silver, one partly open revealing a pale inner surface; tangible hinges and cloth sag; no eye symbol.

Keep each object composition distinct, readable and structurally grounded; the five Night Passage patrons have elemental/material affinities but these objects do not claim established lore or gameplay effects.

outputs.name: Aster cloud vessel
outputs.note: Offset stepped lid, broad slots and stone cradle make a compact solid offering vessel. Warm broad planes stay readable without repeating the bolt mark.

outputs.name: Neris current coffer
outputs.note: Supported hinged lid, hollow rim and aqua insert read at native/compact sizes. Exterior planes lean toward stone rather than glazed ceramic; material remains a proposal.

outputs.name: Vesta ember press
outputs.note: Screw, connected frame, slotted copper cheek and recessed coal read clearly. Strong supported construction distinguishes it from an existing brazier or furnace monument.

outputs.name: Isen salt casket
outputs.note: Sliding thick lid, open dark cavity and icy rim establish a distinct long casket. Broad pale surfaces stay legible; fine frost is intentionally subordinate.

outputs.name: Nyra folded screen
outputs.note: Unequal panels, feet and actual hinge positions are clear at compact size. The returned panels are gray and rigid rather than the requested plum cloth; useful screen construction study, not a finished patron-material match.
